description: Verify an access key and report what it unlocks. Returns valid:true/false; when valid, the tier, when it was created, the premium slugs it unlocks, and that it grants the gated /api/corpus.full.jsonl + get_full_corpus deliverable. Never returns the key, email, or Stripe session. Use this to confirm a freshly-purchased key works before relying on it.
name: check_access
title: Check access key
